L185 주석 '! D2H pack'은 스테이징 방향 서술(L170 device→host)과 맞지만 cudaMemcpy2D 호출 자체에는 방향 인자가 없어(host/device 판단은 인터페이스) 실제 전송 방향은 소스 대조 필요

audit_member_text: Blackwell port updates only Makefile_cuda to nvfortran/cc120 (lines 31, 37), while Makefile_mgpu remains FC=mpif90 with -Mcuda=cuda10.1 (line 33). Therefore the described MGPU path is not shown as compatible with the CUDA12+/Blackwell requirement that motivated the port.

CUDA runtime cudaMemcpy2D pitch and width arguments are described and passed as Mloc/Nghost element counts (lines 188-193). The API normally specifies pitches and width in bytes; no multiplication by real/integer element size or Fortran overload semantics is shown, creating a byte-vs-element unit mismatch risk for all staged halo copies.

device selection uses dev=newRank without querying device count or taking a modulo (lines 159-162). More MPI ranks than GPUs on a node can pass an out-of-range device id before the later memory guard.

cudaMemcpy2dAsync is claimed to overlap X/Y exchanges (lines 201-210), but rmsgx/smsgx host buffers are not identified as pinned/page-locked. Without pinned host memory the copy may serialize or fail to provide the claimed overlap.

the MGPU tridiagonal snippet receives and sends 2*Nloc MPI_SP elements but the visible cudaMemcpy2D copies only Nloc by one row for myDx_T (lines 201-206). The omitted ellipsis may contain the second coefficient copy; the displayed interface does not account for all transferred elements.
edge ranks change sweep start to Ibeg+1/Jbeg+1 when MPI_PROC_NULL (line 212). No boundary equation is given to show why skipping the first interior index is correct rather than an off-by-one loss.

inner-tile output covers 14 cells per block, but this section does not show breaking_kernel's launch grid denominator (lines 122-136). If the grid were sized with 16 rather than Inner=14, the domain tail would be uncovered.
CudaMemUse checks >80% only after cudaMemGetInfo and is described as warning+STOP (lines 167-168); return status, totalMem=0, and allocation-failure handling are not given.

the note describes a source read and mechanisms but no multi-GPU execution result, halo numerical comparison, or stream-race test. MGPU correctness remains unvalidated within this file (lines 154-213).
